data: Does the perplexity of the 'learned' method decrease over time?

The caption states that the figure shows test perplexity per epoch. The lines represent different methods: random, flat, and learned. The x-axis represents epochs, and the y-axis represents perplexity. The learned line is green and appears to decrease over time, while the other two lines also show some decrease but not as steep as the learned line. Therefore, the perplexity of the 'learned' method decreases over time.
